subject: english
title: People are people ⚽ (Unit 1)
intro: Narodnosti, družina, have got, his ali he's in can – z nogometnimi zvezdniki. Najprej kratko ponovi pravila, potem gremo na naloge!

learn.title: Država ali narodnost?
learn.text: Država (country) je kraj na zemljevidu. Narodnost (nationality) pove, kdo je od tam. Narodnosti in jezike v angleščini vedno pišemo z veliko začetnico.
learn.example: Slovenia → Slovenian, Italy → Italian, Japan → Japanese, France → French, Germany → German, Holland → Dutch, Scotland → Scottish, the USA → American

learn.title: have got ali has got?
learn.text: I, you, we, they → have got (I've got). He, she, it → has got (she's got). Zanikanje: haven't got / hasn't got. Vprašanje: Have you got …? Has he got …?
learn.example: Jan Oblak has got big hands. We haven't got a dog. Has your brother got a bike?

learn.title: his ali he's?
learn.text: his = njegov (his eyes, his team). he's = he is ali he has (He's eleven. He's got green eyes.). Še ostali: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
learn.example: He's my best friend. His favourite player is Mbappé.

learn.title: can / can't
learn.text: S can povemo, kaj kdo zna: She can swim. He can't fly. Vprašanje: Can you …? Kratek odgovor: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
learn.example: Can you speak German? No, I can't, but I can speak Slovenian.

learn.title: There are …
learn.text: »V moji sobi sta dve okni« po angleško NI »In my room have two windows«. Pravilno je: There are two windows in my room.
learn.example: There are eleven players in a football team.

goals.text: Znam povedati, od kod je kdo in kakšne narodnosti je (Japan → Japanese).
Znam poimenovati člane družine (aunt, cousin, grandmother …).
Znam uporabljati have got in has got.
Znam ločiti his (njegov) in he's (on je).
Znam povedati, kaj kdo zna in česa ne (can / can't).
Znam opisati prijatelja: videz, osebnost in kaj zna.

sections.title: Države in narodnosti
sections.text:
Država (country) je kraj na zemljevidu. Narodnost (nationality) pove, kdo je od tam. Beseda za narodnost je pogosto tudi beseda za jezik: French = francoski in francoščina.

**Narodnosti pišemo vedno z veliko začetnico.**
examples: Messi is from Argentina. He's Argentinian.
Where are you from? I'm from Slovenia. I'm Slovenian.

sections.title: Družina (Family)
sections.text: S **'s** povemo, čigav je kdo: my mum's sister = mamina sestra = my aunt. Pri več ljudeh samo apostrof: my parents' car.
examples: My mum's sister is my aunt.
My uncle's son is my cousin.
There are five people in my family.

sections.title: have got / has got
sections.text: S have got povemo, kaj kdo **ima**: stvari, družino, videz (oči, lase).
examples: Has your brother got a bike? Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.

sections.title: My, your, his … (čigavo je)
sections.text: Svojilni zaimki povedo, čigavo je nekaj.
examples: He's my friend. His favourite player is Mbappé.

sections.title: can / can't (kaj kdo zna)
sections.text: S **can** povemo, kaj kdo zna. Can je pri vseh osebah enak: I can, he can, they can. Vprašanje: Can you …? Kratek odgovor: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
examples: I can swim but I can't fly.
Can you speak German? No, I can't.
How many languages can you speak?

sections.title: Opis osebe (Describing people)
sections.text: Dober opis gre po vrsti: kdo je → koliko je star → od kod je → videz (He's got …) → osebnost (He's funny) → kaj zna (He can …). Povedi poveži z **and** ali **but**.
examples: My best friend is eleven. He's from Slovenia.
He's tall and he's got short dark hair.
He's funny and clever. He can play football but he can't sing.

sections.title: Oblačila (Clothes)
examples: He's got a blue jacket and black jeans.

tasks.prompt: Jan Oblak is from Slovenia. He's …
tasks.solution: **Slovenian** je narodnost, Slovenia je država. Jan Oblak is Slovenian.

tasks.prompt: Kylian Mbappé is from France. He's …
hints: Kratka beseda, ki se konča na -ch.
tasks.solution: France → **French**. Mbappé is French.

tasks.prompt: Katera beseda je DRŽAVA (country)?
hints: Država je kraj na zemljevidu. Narodnost pove, kdo je od tam.
tasks.solution: **Japan** je država. Japanese je narodnost in jezik: People from Japan are Japanese.

tasks.prompt: My mum's sister is my …
tasks.solution: Mamina sestra je **aunt** (teta). Uncle = stric, cousin = bratranec ali sestrična.

tasks.prompt: Ana ___ got long hair.
hints: Ana = she. Kaj sodi k he, she, it?
tasks.solution: Pri he, she, it: **has got**. Ana has got long hair. (I, you, we, they have got.)

tasks.prompt: Kateri zapis je pravilen?
tasks.solution: Narodnosti in jezike pišemo z **veliko začetnico**: French, English, Slovenian.

tasks.prompt: Država → narodnost. Italy → ______
hints: Ne Italy! Narodnost se tukaj konča na -ian.
tasks.solution: Italy → **Italian**. Pizza is Italian!

tasks.prompt: Dopolni s have got ali has got: Jan Oblak ______ big hands.
accept: 's got
tasks.solution: He → **has got**: Jan Oblak has got big hands. Krajše: He's got big hands.

tasks.prompt: ___ favourite player is Mbappé.
tasks.solution: **His** = njegov: His favourite player is Mbappé. He's = he is (on je).

tasks.prompt: Država → narodnost. Japan → ______
tasks.solution: Japan → **Japanese**.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni s have got ali has got: The players ______ new boots.
accept: 've got
tasks.solution: They → **have got**: The players have got new boots. Krajše: They've got new boots.

tasks.prompt: ___ eleven years old.
tasks.solution: **He's** = he is: He's eleven years old. His = njegov.

tasks.prompt: Država → narodnost. Holland → ______
hints: Ta je posebna: ne konča se na -ish.
Ima pet črk in se začne z D.
tasks.solution: Holland → **Dutch**. Virgil van Dijk is Dutch.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni kratek odgovor. »Can you speak German?« »No, I ______.«
accept: cannot
can not
tasks.solution: No, I **can't**. Kratek odgovor ponovi can: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

tasks.prompt: Poslušaj in zapiši oblačilo.
hints: Nosimo jih na nogah pri športu.
tasks.solution: **trainers** = superge. Za nogomet pa imamo boots (kopačke).

tasks.prompt: Bonus: poslušaj in zapiši družinskega člana.
hints: To je hčerka. Črk gh se ne sliši.
d _ _ g h t e r
tasks.solution: **daughter** = hčerka (son = sin). Črk gh v daughter ne izgovorimo.

tasks.prompt: My dad's father is my ______.
accept: grandpa
granddad
grandad
tasks.solution: **grandfather** (ali grandpa) = dedek. Grandmother (grandma) = babica.

tasks.prompt: Popravi poved: »In my class have twenty pupils.«
tasks.answer: There are twenty pupils in my class.
accept: There are 20 pupils in my class.
hints: There are … pupils in my class.
tasks.solution: **There are twenty pupils in my class.** (= V mojem razredu je dvajset učencev.) Slovenskega »imamo« tu ne prevajamo dobesedno.

tasks.prompt: Popravi poved: »She have a new bike.«
tasks.answer: She has got a new bike.
accept: She's got a new bike.
She has a new bike.
hints: She = ona. Kaj sodi k she?
tasks.solution: **She has got a new bike.** (ali She's got a new bike.) Pri he, she, it: has, ne have.

tasks.prompt: Popravi poved: »Hes favourite colour is blue.«
accept: His favorite color is blue.
His favourite color is blue.
His favorite colour is blue.
tasks.solution: **His** favourite colour is blue. His = njegov, he's = he is.

tasks.prompt: Popravi poved: »Mbappé is France.«
accept: Mbappé is from France.
hints: France je država. Uporabi narodnost ali pa dodaj from.
tasks.solution: **Mbappé is French.** ali **Mbappé is from France.**

tasks.prompt: Sestavi vprašanje: speak / languages / can / how many / you / ?
tasks.answer: How many languages can you speak?
hints: How many languages + can + you + speak?
tasks.solution: **How many languages can you speak?** Vrstni red: vprašalnica + can + oseba + glagol.

tasks.prompt: Združi povedi z and ali but: Ronaldo can play football. He can't fly.
tasks.answer: Ronaldo can play football but he can't fly.
accept: Ronaldo can play football but can't fly.
Ronaldo can play football but he cannot fly.
hints: Ene stvari zna, druge ne. Kateri veznik pove nasprotje?
tasks.solution: **Ronaldo can play football but he can't fly.** But uporabimo za nasprotje, and za dve podobni stvari.

tasks.prompt: Mini spis v zvezek: v štirih povedih opiši svojega najljubšega nogometaša. Uporabi: He's from … / He's … (narodnost) / He's got … / He can … but he can't …
hints: Začni z: My favourite football player is …
Narodnost z veliko začetnico, pri he pa has got.
tasks.solution: Primer: My favourite football player is Jan Oblak. He's from Slovenia, so he's Slovenian. He's got short hair and big hands. He can stop penalties but he can't play in attack!

tasks.prompt: Bonus: Somebody who isn't scared is …
hints: Katniss iz The Hunger Games ni prestrašena.
tasks.solution: **brave** = pogumen, pogumna. Nervous = živčen, quiet = tih.

challenge.prompt: Prevedi v angleščino: Moj bratranec je Italijan.
accept: My cousin's Italian.

challenge.prompt: Prevedi: Ona ima dolge lase in modre oči.
challenge.answer: She has got long hair and blue eyes.
accept: She's got long hair and blue eyes.
She has long hair and blue eyes.
hints: Uporabi has got. Lasje = hair (brez s!).
challenge.solution: **She has got long hair and blue eyes.** (She's got …) Hair je v angleščini brez s.

challenge.prompt: Prevedi: Ali ima tvoj oče avto?
challenge.answer: Has your dad got a car?
accept: Has your father got a car?
Does your dad have a car?
Does your father have a car?
challenge.solution: **Has your dad got a car?** Kratek odgovor: Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.

challenge.prompt: Zanikaj: The Gardners have got a dog. → The Gardners ______ a dog.
accept: have not got
challenge.solution: The Gardners **haven't got** a dog. (The Gardners = they.)

challenge.prompt: Prevedi: Njegova najljubša ekipa je Real Madrid.
challenge.answer: His favourite team is Real Madrid.
accept: His favorite team is Real Madrid.

challenge.prompt: Popravi poved: »My cousins has got a big house.«
challenge.answer: My cousins have got a big house.
challenge.solution: **My cousins have got a big house.** Več bratrancev = they → have got.

challenge.prompt: Popravi drugo poved: »My pen friend is from the USA. She's america.«
accept: She is American.
My pen friend is from the USA. She's American.
My pen friend is from the USA. She is American.

challenge.prompt: Prevedi: Moja sestra zna plavati, ne zna pa voziti avta.
challenge.answer: My sister can swim but she can't drive a car.
accept: My sister can swim but she can't drive.
My sister can swim but can't drive a car.
My sister can swim but can't drive.
My sister can swim but she cannot drive a car.
My sister can swim but she cannot drive.
challenge.solution: **My sister can swim but she can't drive a car.**

challenge.prompt: Sestavi vprašanje za ta odgovor: »Yes, he can! Oblak can catch every ball.«
accept: Can Jan Oblak catch every ball?
Can he catch every ball?
challenge.solution: **Can Oblak catch every ball?** Yes, he can!

challenge.say: My granny is Japanese and my uncle is Dutch.
challenge.answer: My granny is Japanese and my uncle is Dutch.
hints: Uporabi 🐢 za počasno branje. Narodnosti z veliko začetnico.
challenge.solution: **My granny is Japanese and my uncle is Dutch.**

parent.school_method: Wider World 1, Unit 1. The book pairs each country with its nationality (Japan → Japanese), teaches family words, have got / has got (he/she/it → has got), my/your/his/her, and can / can't for abilities. Nationalities always start with a capital letter.

car_questions.q: Where is Mbappé from? What nationality is he?
What is your dad's sister to you?
Say in English: Moj brat ima moder avto.
car_questions.a: My brother has got a blue car.

car_questions.q: One thing you can do and one you can't.
car_questions.a: e.g. I can swim but I can't fly.

tips: Ask for full sentences: that's what the test checks.
Point at players on TV: "Where is he from? What nationality is he?"

oral.question: Where is Kylian Mbappé from, and what nationality is he? Answer in full sentences.
Tell me about your family. Who is in it?
key_points: There are … people in my family / I've got …
oral.model_answer: There are five people in my family: my mum, my dad, my two sisters and me.

oral.question: What has your best friend got? Say two things.
oral.model_answer: My best friend has got a dog and a new bike.

oral.question: Say one thing you can do and one thing you can't do.
oral.model_answer: I can swim but I can't play the guitar.

oral.question: Describe your favourite football player: what does he look like, and what is he like?
oral.model_answer: He's tall and he has got short black hair. He's brave and friendly.
